battle.name: 維州之戰
battle.brief: 貞元十七年七月起，劍南節度使韋皋奉詔以二萬眾分九路出川，與吐蕃爭奪維州、松州一線山地；次年正月，吐蕃內大相論莽熱率十萬眾解圍，於險隘中伏被擒。卡面的科林斯青銅盔屬希臘青銅工藝，與本役相隔逾一千四百年，並未現於川西戰場，它在此標記的是全正面遮蔽視野、逼士卒靠隊形求生的重甲原理。

kit.name: 科林斯青銅盔
kit.history: 全正面開眼的青銅盔。看得見的代價是：戴它的人只能靠隊形活。

countries: 唐德宗貞元十七年（801），唐朝與吐蕃王朝在劍南道邊境的一場攻守戰，交戰主體是唐方的劍南軍系統與吐蕃的東鄙邊軍。唐方由劍南西川節度使韋皋總攝，兵源分幾層：以劍南鎮兵為骨幹，配以雅州、邛州、黎州、巂州等州的鎮兵與經略使部曲；此外有松州、汶川一帶受唐羈縻的羌、戎部落主率領的三部落兵；最外圍還有南詔王異牟尋的南詔軍，在滇西方向牽制吐蕃的昆明、諸濟一線。指揮系統呈現多節度使並列的特徵，韋皋以九路分遣、各路各持一道的方式分派任務，把山地正面攻擊拆解成多條獨立但互相策應的攻勢。吐蕃一方以贊普為最高統帥，內大相論莽熱兼領東鄙五道節度兵馬都統、群牧大使，是這一次行動的實際統帥；其下有維州、保州、松州、棲雞、老翁城、偏松、昆明諸城的地方守軍，以及自西北靈州、朔方方向抽調南下的蕃兵。整場戰爭的實質，是吐蕃在西北線施壓、唐朝在東南線反擊的兩面作戰。
countriesEn: The Battle of Weizhou was fought in 801 between the Tang dynasty and the Tibetan Empire along the frontier of the Jiannan circuit in what is now western Sichuan. On the Tang side the campaign was commanded by Wei Gao, military governor of Jiannan; his forces were layered: the garrison of the Xichuan seat as the backbone, the standing troops and provincial contingents of Yazhou, Qiongzhou, Lizhou and Luzhou, the tribal levies of Qiang and Rong chieftains around Songzhou and Wenchuan who had accepted Tang oversight, and at the outer edge the army of Nanzhao under King Yimengxun, which held the line in Yunnan and kept pressure on Qiongming and Zhuji. The command structure was one of parallel regional commands rather than a single staff: Wei Gao split the assault into nine simultaneous columns, each with its own named route, so that the frontal attack in the mountains was broken into a number of independent but mutually supporting drives. On the Tibetan side the tsapep was the supreme commander, and Lunmangre, the inner minister who also held the titles of commander of the five eastern circuits and minister of the herds, was the actual field leader of this operation; under him stood the garrisons of Weizhou, Baozhou, Songzhou, Qiji, Laoweng and Piasong, the defenders of the Kunming area, and Tibetan troops pulled south from the Lingzhou and Shuofang fronts in the north-west. In essence the war was a two-front operation: the Tibetans pressed in the north-west while the Tang countered by striking deep from the south-east.
people: 決定維州之戰走向的三方人物各有其分。吐蕃方面，內大相論莽熱是全場最關鍵的名字：他以十萬眾馳援維州、昆明，兵力和指揮都在他手上，卻在唐軍設伏的地段中計被擒，這一擒直接令吐蕃的解圍行動崩潰。吐蕃在西北線的攻勢由史籍未記名姓的蕃將率領，801年七月先攻鹽州、再克麟州，殺死唐刺史郭鋒。唐方主角是劍南節度使韋皋，他自德宗貞元初年鎮蜀，經營劍南十餘年，熟悉邊地地形部族，用分路出擊與羈縻諸羌代替正面強攻；唐德宗則以詔令批准這次主動出擊，用意是牽制吐蕃的西北攻勢、減輕朔方與靈州方向的壓力。具體作戰者的名字在《資治通鑑》卷二百三十六中記載得相當細：鎮靜軍兵馬使陳洎統兵一萬出三奇路，威戎軍使崔堯臣率兵一千出龍溪石門路南，維州保州兩州兵馬使仇昱與保州霸州刺史董振率二千進逼維州城，北路兵馬使邢玼與諸州刺史董懷愕率四千攻棲雞、老翁城，都將高倜、王英俊率二千逼故松州，東路兵馬使元膺與郝宗分兵八千出雅邛黎巂諸路，邛州鎮南軍使御史大夫韋良金續進一千三百，雅州經略使路惟明與三部落主趙日進率三千攻偏松等城，黎州經略使王有道與三部落主郝全信率二千渡大渡河深入蕃境，巂州經略使陳孝陽與何大海、韋義率四千攻昆明、諸濟城。南詔王異牟尋則在雲南方向與韋皋配合，使吐蕃腹背受敵。
peopleEn: Three sets of actors decided the outcome. For the Tibetans, Lunmangre was the decisive name: he held both the 100,000-strong relief army and the command of it, and he was captured when he took the bait in the ground Wei Gao had chosen for his ambush, and that single capture destroyed the relief effort. The Tibetan offensive on the north-west front was led by commanders the chronicle does not name; in July 801 they struck at Yanzhou first, then took Linzhou on the twenty-ninth, killing the Tang prefect Guo Feng and burning the walls before withdrawing. On the Tang side the central figure was Wei Gao, military governor of Jiannan, who had held the circuit since the early Zhenyuan era and knew the terrain and the tribes of the border; he replaced a single frontal assault with divergent columns and with winning over the frontier peoples instead of grinding against the enemy in open battle. Emperor Dezong authorised the offensive by edict, its purpose being to pin the Tibetans in the north-west and ease the pressure on Shuofang and Lingzhou. Zizhi Tongjian, juan 236, records the commanders in unusual detail: Chen Ji, commander of the Zhenjing army, with 10,000 men took the Sanqi road; Cui Yaochen of the Weirong army with 1,000 took the southern route out of Longxi and Shimen; Qiu Yu, military commissioner of Weizhou and Baozhou, with Dong Zhen, prefect of Baozhou and Bazhou, with 2,000 drove up to the walls of Tibetan Weizhou; Xing Zhi, northern commander, with the prefects of several circuits including Dong Huai'e, took 4,000 against Qiji and Laoweng; Gao Ti and Wang Yingjun, generals, with 2,000 pressed the old Songzhou; Yuan Ying, eastern commander, with Hao Zong and 8,000 went out by the southern roads of Yazhou, Qiongzhou, Lizhou and Luzhou; Wei Liangjin, commander of Zhenwu at Qiongzhou and censor-in-chief, followed with 1,300; Lu Weiming, military commissioner of Yazhou, with the tribal chief Zhao Rijin and 3,000 attacked the towns of Piasong and Weizhou; Wang Youdao, military commissioner of Lizhou, with the tribal chief Hao Quanxin and 2,000 crossed the Dadu river into Tibetan interior territory; and Chen Xiaoyang, military commissioner of Luzhou, with He Dahai and Wei Yi and 4,000, attacked Kunming and Zhuji. The Nanzhao king Yimengxun cooperated from the south, striking in Yunnan so that the Tibetans were pinned from two sides.
kits: 卡面這件科林斯青銅盔是公元前七世紀中葉希臘世界的工藝：全正面覆面，只留兩道狹窄的目孔與下緣的呼吸開口，銅片以鉚釘固定在頭骨內襯之上，頸甲與頰甲連成一體。它與801年的維州之戰相隔逾一千四百年，不可能出現在川西的戰場上，這一點必須說清楚；它在卡面上標記的，是一種戰術原理：把戴盔者的視野壓到極窄，於是戴盔者只能靠同袍的隊形與聲音行動。真正交手的雙方各有各的裝備。唐軍步卒著札甲、披膊與護臂的明光鎧，軍將戴兜鍪，鎧面以小鉚釘固定；騎兵多披札甲或背甲，配長槊、陌刀與環首刀；遠程火力以弓為主，材官弩與擘張弩用於守城及伏擊前的火力覆蓋，攻壘時另備火箭與砲車，用以燒毀城柵與堡壘。吐蕃步兵以長刀與長矛為主，弓箭數量不少，披皮甲或鎖子甲，頭戴鐵盔或皮盔，善於在高山峽谷中以徒步突進配合騎兵擾亂；其戰馬為吐蕃馬，體小而耐力好，適合長途縱深作戰。劍南軍的馬匹與糧秣大量靠牛、騾、羊馱運，糧道自成都經灌縣、威州、茂州北行，再循大渡河、白水江的溪谷小道轉輸到松州、維州前線；這種高山峽谷的地形，使後勤成為韋皋每一次出兵的真正瓶頸。
kitsEn: The Corinthian helmet on the card is a mid-seventh-century Greek artefact: a full-face covering with only two narrow eye openings and a breathing gap at the lower edge, riveted to a skull liner, with neck and cheek plates joined into one piece. It stands more than fourteen hundred years away from the battle of Weizhou in 801 and could not have been present on a Sichuan battlefield; that must be said plainly. What it marks on the card is a tactical principle: the wearer's field of view is compressed to the narrowest possible slit, so that the wearer can only act by the formation and the voices of the men around him. The actual sides fought with their own gear. Tang infantry wore lamellar armour with sashes and arm guards, commanders wore iron helmets, and armour plates were fastened with small rivets; cavalry were mostly in lamellar or back armour, carrying long spears, the miao dao and ring-pommel swords. Longbows were the principal missile weapon, with crossbows of the material-official and bow-powered types used to cover positions before an ambush and to defend walls, while fire arrows and stone-throwing carts were kept for burning the palisades and stockades of the forts. Tibetan infantry fought with long knives and long spears, carried bows in fair numbers, wore leather or mail, and used iron or hide helmets; they were adept at combining infantry rushes through high gorges with cavalry harassment, and their horses were small but exceptionally hardy, which suited long operations deep into the mountains. The Jiannan army moved its horses and grain largely on oxen, mules and sheep; the supply line ran from Chengdu through Guanxian, Weizhou and Maozhou, then followed the gorges of the Dadu and Baishui rivers to the forward posts at Songzhou and Weizhou, and that high mountain terrain made logistics, rather than fighting, the real constraint on every sortie Wei Gao launched.
tactics: 韋皋的整套部署圍繞三個要點。第一是戰略層面上的兩面作戰：吐蕃把主力壓向西北的靈州、朔方，唐廷不與之爭鋒，而是令劍南軍由東南方向直插吐蕃縱深，把對方有限的兵員拉扯成兩股，迫其在兩個方向同時應戰。第二是戰役層面上的分路合擊：八月至十二月之間，唐軍以三奇路、龍溪石門路南、南道雅州邛州黎州巂州、大渡河越嶺路等命名清楚的行軍路線，由各路兵馬使、經略使、刺史與部落主分率兵眾，目標分別指向維州城、棲雞與老翁城、故松州、偏松、昆明與諸濟城，形成多點同時施壓，迫使守軍分散應付，各城守將無法集中兵力救援彼此。韋良金、路惟明等人的續進顯示，唐軍並非一次押上，而是以梯次配置維持攻勢的連續性。第三是戰術層面上的伏擊：802年正月，論莽熱率十萬眾自西北南下解圍，韋皋得到情報後派西川兵萬餘在援軍必經的險要地段設伏，先以小股出戰挑釁，吐蕃軍追殺唐兵，被有意引向埋伏圈，伏兵同時發動，蕃軍陣形一亂便再也無法恢復，令論莽熱本人被生擒。攻壘時則依靠夜襲、火攻與火箭、砲車等手段，盡量不走正面硬撞城牆的路子。
tacticsEn: Wei Gao's deployment rested on three layers. The first was strategic: the Tibetans had thrown their main weight against Lingzhou and Shuofang in the north-west, and the court chose not to contest that front, instead ordering the Jiannan army to drive deep into Tibetan territory from the south-east and stretch an already finite enemy force in two, forcing it to fight in both directions at once. The second was operational: between the eighth and the twelfth months, Tang columns moved along clearly named roads, the Sanqi road, the southern route out of Longxi and Shimen, the southern roads of Yazhou, Qiongzhou, Lizhou and Luzhou, and the route over the Dadu river, each under its own military commissioner, prefect or tribal chief, with the objectives of the Weizhou walls, Qiji and Laoweng, the old Songzhou, Piasong, and Kunming with Zhuji. Pressure was applied at many points at once, the garrisons were forced to divide, and no single commander could gather troops to relieve another. The follow-up elements sent by Wei Liangjin and Lu Weiming show that the Tang did not commit everything at once but kept the offensive continuous with echeloned reinforcement. The third was tactical: in the first month of 802, Lunmangre marched south with 100,000 men to relieve Weizhou and Kunming; once Wei Gao had word of it he posted more than 10,000 Xichuan troops in ambush on the defiles the relief column had to cross, sent out a small party to give battle and provoke a pursuit, and let the Tibetans chase it deliberately into the killing ground, where the ambush struck all at once; the formation broke, never reformed, and Lunmangre was taken alive. Against the forts the Tang worked at night with fire, using fire arrows and stone-throwing carts rather than driving headlong against a curtain wall.
data: 可引的數字都出自《資治通鑑》卷二百三十六。時間：戰役始於貞元十七年七月（801），至貞元十八年正月（802）伏擊論莽熱止，橫跨約半年。吐蕃在西北線的動作有明確日期：801年七月十八日攻鹽州，七月二十九日攻克麟州，殺死唐刺史郭鋒，毀壞城郭後退去。唐軍首波出兵的總量記為步騎兵二萬，分九路並進；九月再分遣各路時，《通鑑》逐條列出的兵額是：鎮靜軍兵馬使陳洎一萬、威戎軍使崔堯臣一千、仇昱與董振二千、邢玼與董懷愕四千、高倜與王英俊二千、元膺與郝宗八千、韋良金一千三百、路惟明與趙日進三千、王有道與郝全信二千、陳孝陽與何大海、韋義四千，各路相加約三萬七千。戰果方面，《通鑑》記唐軍擊潰吐蕃軍十六萬，攻取城池七座、軍鎮五座，焚毀堡壘一百五十個，斬首萬餘人，俘六千餘人，受降三千餘戶；802年正月論莽熱所率十萬援兵中伏後，士卒死亡大半，其本人被擒。其中「十六萬」明顯帶有史家誇飾的成分，須與斬俘一萬餘、六千餘的數對照着看。
dataEn: The figures available all come from Zizhi Tongjian, juan 236. Timing: the campaign opened in the seventh month of Zhenyuan 17 (801) and closed with the ambush of Lunmangre in the first month of Zhenyuan 18 (802), a span of about half a year. The Tibetan moves on the north-west front carry exact dates: on the eighteenth day of the seventh month of 801 they attacked Yanzhou; on the twenty-ninth they took Linzhou, killed the prefect Guo Feng, destroyed the walls and withdrew. The first wave of the Tang deployment is recorded as 20,000 foot and horse in nine columns; when the columns were detailed in the ninth month, Tongjian gives each separately: 10,000 under Chen Ji of the Zhenjing army, 1,000 under Cui Yaochen of Weirong, 2,000 under Qiu Yu and Dong Zhen, 4,000 under Xing Zhi and Dong Huai'e, 2,000 under Gao Ti and Wang Yingjun, 8,000 under Yuan Ying and Hao Zong, 1,300 under Wei Liangjin, 3,000 under Lu Weiming and Zhao Rijin, 2,000 under Wang Youdao and Hao Quanxin, and 4,000 under Chen Xiaoyang, He Dahai and Wei Yi, about 37,000 in all. On results, Tongjian says the Tang routed 160,000 Tibetan troops, took seven cities and five military towns, burned 150 stockades, cut off more than 10,000 by the head, took 6,000 prisoners and received the surrender of more than 3,000 households; in the first month of 802, after the ambush, more than half of Lunmangre's 100,000 were killed or wounded and he himself was captured. The figure of 160,000 carries the obvious exaggeration of the chronicler and should be read against the 10,000 killed and the 6,000 captured.
cause: 維州之戰的起因要從兩條線說。一條是西北線的壓力：801年七月，吐蕃先攻鹽州，又於七月二十九日克麟州、殺刺史郭鋒，顯示吐蕃在西北兩線同時用兵，唐廷必須回應。另一條是劍南線的邊界危機：維州治薛城、松州治嘉誠，是唐蕃在川西的兩個前哨，扼着自成都北上松潘高原的門戶。史載790年吐蕃攻陷維州、刺史楊定被擒，韋皋用反間與奇襲之策在次年收復維州；但那樣的邊州守得極不穩，韋皋鎮蜀十餘年一直以羈縻諸羌、離間諸蕃鞏固這一段邊界，也一直等待把邊防推成進攻的機會。801年吐蕃在西北大舉用兵，唐廷據此判定其東南線兵力相對空虛，於是下詔令劍南軍主動出擊，目標直指維州、松州、棲雞、老翁城一線，把西南戰場由防守轉為進攻，用以分擔朔方、靈州方向的壓力。南詔與唐的結盟是這次行動能成立的另一個前提：異牟尋依韋皋之請出兵配合，指向雲南方向的昆明與諸濟城，使吐蕃腹背同時受敵。
causeEn: The causes of the battle lie along two threads. The first is the pressure on the north-west front: in July 801 the Tibetans attacked Yanzhou, then took Linzhou on the twenty-ninth and killed the prefect Guo Feng, which showed they were fighting on two fronts at once, and the court had to answer. The second is the fragility of the Jiannan frontier: Weizhou, seated at Xuecheng, and Songzhou, seated at Jiacheng, were Tang outposts on the western Sichuan border and the gateways to Songpan, the plateau north of Chengdu. The chronicle records that the Tibetans took Weizhou in 790 and captured its prefect Yang Ding, and that Wei Gao recovered the city the following year by a combination of dissension and a surprise; but a border prefecture like that was never securely held, and over more than a decade Wei Gao consolidated that stretch by winning over the Qiang and dividing the Tibetans, all the while waiting for the moment to turn defence into advance. The Tibetan concentration in the north-west in 801 told the court that the south-east was thinner, and the edict therefore ordered the Jiannan army to strike at Weizhou, Songzhou, Qiji and Laoweng, so as to carry the war from the defensive to the offensive and share the burden on the Shuofang and Lingzhou fronts. The alliance with Nanzhao was a second precondition: Yimengxun moved in step with Wei Gao's request, striking towards Kunming and Zhuji in Yunnan, and pinching the Tibetans from two directions.
impact: 維州之戰對唐蕃格局的影響，超出它本身的戰果。第一層是戰役層面的：801至802年間，唐軍在川西連續奪城破堡，把吐蕃在松潘高原東南麓的據點逐個拔除，維州、昆明之圍先後解除，劍南防線第一次從韋皋的經營變成可以主動使用的攻勢。吐蕃的內大相論莽熱被生擒、十萬援軍潰散，內部震動，自此對川西的用兵不得不更加倚重兵力，而每一次調兵都更容易被唐廷抓住空檔。第二層是唐蕃外交層面的：南詔在這次行動中與唐朝形成實際的協同，異牟尋此後不再服從吐蕃的調度，唐蕃西南方向的力量對比在數年內被徹底扭轉，昆明一帶的羈縻體系也隨之重建，此後南詔兵進入昆明、置立軍鎮即以此役為前提。第三層是邊防體制與唐廷內部的：韋皋以節度使兼領數州、兼理各州鎮兵的體制，證明了在藩鎮割據的年代裡，一方藩鎮的軍力足以承擔跨州區的大戰役；這既提高了劍南的地位，也加深了中央對強藩的依賴。戰役之後，唐蕃在西北與西南兩線上都有所收斂，二十餘年相對平靜的局面由此鋪開，直到長慶會盟前後才再起大規模衝突。
impactEn: The effect of the battle on the Tang-Tibetan balance was larger than its immediate results. At the operational level, the Tang army took cities and stockades one after another in western Sichuan between 801 and 802, stripping the Tibetan footholds off the south-eastern edge of the Songpan plateau; the sieges of Weizhou and Kunming were relieved in turn, and the Jiannan line changed for the first time from something Wei Gao merely defended into an offensive the court could use. The capture of the inner minister Lunmangre and the destruction of his 100,000-strong relief force shook the Tibetan court, which thereafter had to lean more heavily on mass for its operations in the west, and every redeployment of troops gave the Tang another opening. At the diplomatic level, Nanzhao and the Tang fought in real coordination for the first time, and Yimengxun ceased to answer Tibetan summons; the balance of power in the south-west was overturned within a few years, the frontier administration around Kunming was rebuilt, and Nanzhao's entry into Kunming and the establishment of a military command there followed directly from this campaign. At the institutional level, the fact that a circuit governor could hold several prefectures and command their troops showed that a single provincial army could carry a campaign across prefectural lines; it raised the standing of Jiannan while deepening the court's dependence on strong governors. The war also had a cooling effect on both the north-west and the south-west fronts, and a relative peace lasting more than two decades followed, until large-scale fighting resumed around the time of the Changqing oath.
result: 結果是唐軍完勝。801年八月至十二月，劍南軍分九路進攻，先後攻取吐蕃城池七座、軍鎮五座，焚毀堡壘一百五十個，斬首萬餘人，俘六千餘人，受降三千餘戶，維州、松州、棲雞、老翁城、偏松等地相繼易手，吐蕃在川西的統治結構被打散。802年正月，論莽熱率十萬眾南下解維州與昆明之圍，行至唐軍設伏地段，先以挑釁誘其追殺唐兵，隨即遭伏兵攻擊，蕃軍大亂，論莽熱本人被唐軍生擒，士卒死傷大半，解圍的企圖徹底破滅。這一役之後，吐蕃在劍南方向轉入守勢，唐朝則第一次以主動出擊的方式在西線與南線同時施壓，並藉此鞏固了松州至維州的邊防體系；南詔與唐的軍事合作也由此固定，昆明一線的羈縻經營在隨後數年落實。維州之戰的意義因此不只在一座城，而在於唐蕃在西南邊界的攻防主動權，在801年之後的一個世代裡，穩穩地握在了唐朝手上。
resultEn: The result was a clear Tang victory. Between the eighth and the twelfth months of 801 the Jiannan army attacked in nine columns, taking seven Tibetan cities and five military towns, burning 150 stockades, cutting off more than 10,000 by the head, taking 6,000 prisoners and receiving the surrender of more than 3,000 households; Weizhou, Songzhou, Qiji, Laoweng and Piasong changed hands one after another and the Tibetan structure of command in western Sichuan was broken up. In the first month of 802 Lunmangre marched south with 100,000 men to relieve Weizhou and Kunming, was drawn on by a challenge from a small Tang force, ambushed in the defile, thrown into confusion, and taken alive with most of his men killed or wounded; the relief was finished. After this the Tibetans went over to the defensive in Jiannan, while the Tang for the first time applied pressure on the western and southern fronts at the same time by choice, and consolidated the frontier system running from Songzhou to Weizhou. The military cooperation between Nanzhao and the Tang was fixed, and the frontier administration around Kunming was carried out in the following years. The significance of the battle therefore lies not in one city but in the fact that for a generation after 801 the initiative on the south-western frontier of the Tang-Tibetan war stayed firmly in Tang hands.
